fictional_data_declaration: This is fictional synthetic user-research material created for software evaluation and demonstration.

adoption_constraints: Staff need to see which required field failed validation
observations.confidence_note: Repeated operational example, but frequency is participant-reported.
observations.current_workaround: Open the referral and compare administrative fields against a checklist.
observations.desired_outcome: Flag missing structured fields before the referral enters the review queue.
governance_constraints: Any external request must remain staff-approved
observations.reported_problem: GP-practice submissions often need another administrative information check.
observations.supporting_quote: I want the missing fields shown before I start the full check, not another hidden rule.

adoption_constraints: Warnings must not block valid exception cases
observations.confidence_note: Clear workflow description from one role; source causes were not verified.
observations.current_workaround: Repeat the checklist when new information arrives.
observations.desired_outcome: Retain a visible record of completed checks and changed fields.
governance_constraints: Preserve the original submission and every override
observations.reported_problem: Information updates create repeated completeness checks and duplicated effort.
observations.supporting_quote: When an update lands, we cannot always tell what changed, so the safe option is to check again.

adoption_constraints: An easy manual retry and override must remain available
observations.confidence_note: Direct walkthrough of the scheduling queue; no time-and-motion study.
observations.current_workaround: Maintain a separate retry list and reopen failed attempts manually.
observations.desired_outcome: Create a clear staff-owned retry queue with failure reasons.
governance_constraints: Do not book or contact anyone without staff action
observations.reported_problem: Failed scheduling attempts are easy to lose among new work.
observations.supporting_quote: A retry should come back with context, but I still need to decide the next administrative step.

adoption_constraints: Queue reasons must distinguish waiting from data failure
observations.confidence_note: Consistent with the walkthrough, though closure policy varies by team.
observations.current_workaround: Use calendar reminders and inspect open cases individually.
observations.desired_outcome: Surface stalled scheduling cases for a coordinator to review.
governance_constraints: A monitor must not choose a closure outcome
observations.reported_problem: Non-response and long waits can leave cases without a clear next owner.
observations.supporting_quote: A reminder is useful; deciding whether the case closes is still our job.

adoption_constraints: Routing logic must be inspectable by operations
observations.confidence_note: Management view supported by queue reviews, not direct observation of every exception.
observations.current_workaround: Escalate older unassigned cases during daily queue review.
observations.desired_outcome: Use explicit administrative rules to suggest an operational team sooner.
governance_constraints: Routing must remain reviewable and reversible
observations.reported_problem: Neurology referrals wait in the assignment queue longer than managers expect.
observations.supporting_quote: A routing suggestion could remove queue time, but the reason for it has to be visible.

adoption_constraints: A coordinator must confirm exceptions before ownership changes
observations.confidence_note: Detailed exception examples, but their population frequency is unknown.
observations.current_workaround: Review structured notes and redirect administrative exceptions manually.
observations.desired_outcome: Show a suggested route with the rule and preserve manual selection.
governance_constraints: No silent routing and no inference from narrative text
observations.reported_problem: A single automatic routing rule would miss operational exceptions.
observations.supporting_quote: Most cases look routine until an exception changes which team can own the work.

observations.confidence_note: Observed handoff workflow; whether each handoff was avoidable was not established.
observations.current_workaround: Message the next coordinator and update ownership manually.
observations.desired_outcome: Make ownership rules and handoff reasons explicit before reassignment.
governance_constraints: Do not suppress valid specialist handoffs
observations.reported_problem: Reassignment creates extra coordination and unclear ownership.
observations.supporting_quote: The delay is not only the reassignment; it is finding who owns the next step.

observations.confidence_note: Source behaviour is instrumented, but timestamp meaning differs between systems.
observations.current_workaround: Inspect retry logs after an operational discrepancy is reported.
observations.desired_outcome: Monitor delayed, repeated, and out-of-order events by source.
governance_constraints: Do not interpret data latency as staff performance
observations.reported_problem: Source retries and late timestamps can make an event history look misleading.
observations.supporting_quote: We need to know whether an event was late before treating the sequence as an operational issue.

adoption_constraints: Prototype in recommendation-only mode with sampled review
observations.confidence_note: Policy constraint is clear; implementation controls require later design.
observations.current_workaround: Require staff to initiate external communication and ownership changes.
observations.desired_outcome: Retain approval, audit, fallback, and reversible handling for every future action.
observations.reported_problem: Automation enthusiasm can hide approval and audit requirements.
observations.supporting_quote: A useful suggestion is not permission to act; approval and a record are separate requirements.

adoption_constraints: Only explicit administrative fields may be used
observations.confidence_note: Strong governance position; exception frequency remains an operational question.
observations.current_workaround: Staff verify the operational route before assigning ownership.
observations.desired_outcome: Make routing assistance explainable and always subject to confirmation.
observations.reported_problem: Automatic routing could silently apply an incomplete rule.
observations.supporting_quote: If the rule cannot explain its administrative inputs, it should not propose a route.
